name: Career Essentials in Cybersecurity by Microsoft and LinkedIn
description: Four-course professional certificate from Microsoft and LinkedIn Learning covering the cybersecurity threat landscape, security terminology, cybersecurity frameworks and standards (NIST, COBIT), and AI-powered security operations with Microsoft Security Copilot. Completed all 4 courses (6 hours) and passed the final assessment.

criteria.narrative: Completed all four courses in the Career Essentials in Cybersecurity by Microsoft and LinkedIn learning path on LinkedIn Learning: The Cybersecurity Threat Landscape, Cybersecurity Awareness: Cybersecurity Terminology, Cybersecurity Foundations, and Microsoft Security Copilot. Passed the final summative assessment to earn the certificate.
